name: Regina Miracle International (Holdings) Limited
summary: Regina Miracle International (Holdings) Limited, an investment holding company, designs, manufactures, and trades in a range of intimate wear and sports products. The company operates through four segments: Intimate Wear, Sports Products, Consumer Electronics Components, and Bra Pads and Other Accessory Products. The company offers bras, bra tops, panties, shapewear, and swimwear; sports bras, leggings, and functional sportswear; virtual reality headsets, and tablet; and bra pads, one-piece moulded hats, footwear, and other accessory products.
